summary: Two clients on a NIFTY future: a Quote holder, then a Depth holder moves the preference from QUOTE to FULL in one frame; one FULL packet serves both, with its OI; the Depth holder leaving moves it back to QUOTE and the Quote holder keeps streaming.

notes: The web adds a second preference (FULL beside QUOTE) and keys token_map by the security id with the mode subscribed last; the Depth holder leaving deletes that key (paytm_adapter.py:500-501), so the web's Quote holder receives nothing more.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Paytm web adapter puts the subscription mode number there (1, 2, 3). Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The web passes Paytm's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
deviations.ref: paytm_adapter.py:702, 709, 728 (raw last_traded_time); audit remaining brokers matrix (Paytm: native seconds -> ms)

deviations.reason: The desktop sends last_quantity beside last_trade_quantity; the Paytm web adapter's Quote frame names it last_trade_quantity only. Names follow each broker's own web adapter, mode by mode (lead ruling 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The desktop sends last_trade_quantity beside last_quantity in Quote and Depth alike; the Paytm web adapter's Depth frame names it last_quantity only. Names follow each broker's own web adapter, mode by mode (lead ruling 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.
The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest; the Paytm web adapter sends oi only. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.
deviations.ref: paytm_adapter.py:745-747; feed::protocol::market_data; feed::dialect (per-broker switch, lane wire)

deviations.reason: The web sends the change Paytm's packet carries in every mode; the desktop decodes it (NormalizedTick::change) and sends it in index frames only.
deviations.ref: paytm_adapter.py:703, 719, 738; audit C04 (change on all exchanges)

deviations.reason: The web sends the FULL packet's OI change in Depth frames; the desktop does not decode it and its common carrier has no place for it.
The web forwards the FULL packet's DEPTH publish unchanged to a Quote holder (server.py fan-out to lower modes), book included; the desktop renders the Quote holder's frame at Quote.

When the Depth holder leaves, the web adapter deletes the security id from token_map (paytm_adapter.py:500-501) although the Quote holder's preference is still on the wire, so every later packet is dropped as untracked and the web's Quote holder receives nothing more. The desktop moves the preference back to QUOTE and keeps streaming to it.
The web sends the packet's 52-week high and low in Quote and Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for them.
